description: This file defines an Android activity class 'CustomTitle' that demonstrates how to use a custom window title feature in an Android application. It initializes UI components, sets a custom title layout, and handles button clicks to update title text views.

classes.name: CustomTitle
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating how to implement a custom title using the FEATURE_CUSTOM_TITLE window feature.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets a custom title layout, and establishes click handlers for updating title text views.
